classification.zh: 新艺术与工艺美术气质融合的装饰性田园插画
classification.en: A decorative pastoral illustration combining Art Nouveau and Arts and Crafts qualities

summary.zh: 以钴蓝天空与清新绿色打开画面。细金线贯穿叶脉、枝条和云纹，让自然景观具有精密的装饰秩序。
summary.en: Cobalt blue sky and fresh greens open up the image. Fine gold lines run through leaf veins, branches and cloud patterns, giving the natural landscape an intricate ornamental order.

recognition.zh: 与金箔森林同属装饰植物语言；这一条目以明亮日光、蓝天和细金线作为主要识别线索。
recognition.en: This case shares a decorative botanical language with the Forest with a Gold-Leaf Effect; bright daylight, blue sky and fine gold lines are its main identifying cues.

reuse_focus.zh: 用金线重新组织既有植物、云层与建筑边缘，保留明亮空间和视觉留白。
reuse_focus.en: Use gold lines to reorganize existing plants, clouds and architectural edges, retaining the bright space and visually open areas.

judgment_note.zh: “新艺术＋工艺美术”是对可见装饰语言的判断，不代表已核实作品所属历史流派。
judgment_note.en: “Art Nouveau + Arts and Crafts” is an interpretation of the visible decorative language, not a verified historical classification of the work.

caption.zh: 蓝天、金线云纹与繁密植物
caption.en: Blue sky, gold-lined cloud patterns and dense vegetation

alt.zh: 蓝天与白云下的绿色田园树林，金色线条装饰叶片、树干和云朵
alt.en: Green pastoral woodland beneath blue sky and white clouds, with gold lines decorating leaves, trunks and clouds

credit.zh: 用户提供 · 作者待补

text.zh: 细金线勾勒叶脉与枝条；云朵中的卷曲线条，把自然形态转化为装饰图案。
text.en: Fine gold lines trace leaf veins and branches; curling lines within the clouds turn natural forms into decorative patterns.

text.zh: 钴蓝天空与层次丰富的绿色形成主色关系，象牙白花朵和金色线条带出日光。
text.en: Cobalt blue sky and richly varied greens establish the main color relationship, while ivory flowers and gold lines suggest daylight.

text.zh: 密集但清晰的植物重复、细小花朵与纸面笔触，形成壁纸、织毯般的手工观感。
text.en: Dense yet distinct repetitions of plants, tiny flowers and brushwork on a paper-like surface create a handmade appearance reminiscent of wallpaper or tapestry.

text.zh: 前景叶片近似平面装饰，树林、溪流与山坡仍有纵深；细节集中在植物和轮廓上。
text.en: The foreground leaves resemble flat ornament, while the woodland, stream and hillside retain depth; detail is concentrated in the vegetation and contours.

text.zh: 清新、宁静、理想化的田园世界。迁移时优先保留原场景，不必新增溪流或蘑菇。
text.en: A fresh, peaceful, idealized pastoral world. When transferring the style, prioritize preserving the original scene; there is no need to add streams or mushrooms.

legacy_prompts.zh: 将输入照片完整改绘为新艺术与工艺美术气质融合的装饰性田园插画。照片决定内容、视角与构图；附加参考图仅提供风格语言。保留主体数量与身份、主要物件位置、建筑或地形结构、画幅比例。使用优雅的有机曲线、细金色轮廓与叶脉、密集而有节奏的植物纹样。以钴蓝、森林绿、翠绿、象牙白和赭金构成明亮配色，用柔和日光形成清新宁静的童话田园气氛。在原图已有植物、云层、织物或装饰表面加入图案，保留主体附近的视觉留白与空间纵深。整体呈精细手绘与轻微纸面颜料质感。不要导入参考中的溪流、山丘、蘑菇或新人物，不要添加文字、水印或边框，不要只叠加色彩滤镜。
legacy_prompts.en: Fully reinterpret the input photograph as a decorative pastoral illustration combining Art Nouveau and Arts and Crafts qualities. The photograph determines content, viewpoint and composition; additional reference images provide stylistic language only. Preserve subject count and identities, the positions of main objects, architectural or terrain structures, and aspect ratio. Use graceful organic curves, fine gold contours and leaf veins, and dense yet rhythmic botanical patterns. Build a bright palette of cobalt blue, forest green, emerald green, ivory and ochre-gold, using soft daylight to create a fresh, peaceful, fairy-tale pastoral atmosphere. Add patterns to plants, clouds, textiles or decorative surfaces already in the original image, retaining visually open areas around the main subject and spatial depth. Give the whole image a finely hand-painted appearance with subtle pigment-on-paper texture. Do not import streams, hills, mushrooms or new people from the reference. Do not add text, watermarks or borders, or merely overlay a color filter.

credit.zh: 输入：用户照片 · 输出：AI 改绘

examples.execution_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit Image 1, the landscape photograph of a sunny leafy public park, using Image 2 only as the visual style reference. Produce a refined, richly detailed Art Nouveau and Arts and Crafts decorative pastoral illustration of THE SAME PARK. Preserve Image 1's 4:3 landscape framing, viewpoint, composition, main tree placements and branching silhouettes, layered canopy, open lawn, horizontal walkway, dense foreground hedge, sweeping curved low mosaic-tiled bench/wall across the lower foreground, paved foreground, right-hand small bench, distant buildings and small existing people in their positions. The original photographed location must remain clearly recognizable. Transform every part into cohesive hand-painted storybook artwork with the exact visual vocabulary of Image 2: fine warm golden contour lines and leaf veins, elegant organic curves, dense individually painted foliage with patterned botanical repetition, deep forest green, jade and fresh spring greens, rich cobalt-blue glimpses of sky, ivory and ochre-gold highlights, tiny warm red accents, intricate tapestry-like detail, subtle gouache/oil paint texture on paper, luminous gentle daylight, enchanting peaceful pastoral mood. Reinterpret the foreground hedge as exquisite overlapping botanical leaves and tiny floral motifs with delicate gold outlines; reinterpret the curved tiled bench as an ornate small mosaic of green, ivory, russet and gold while retaining its original shape and position. Stylize existing tree trunks with warm gold line work, retaining pale bases. Use graceful gold swirling ornamental accents sparingly within the existing visible blue sky areas, as in the reference. Make this a substantial painted style transformation, fully illustrated, elegant and richly crafted, with refined fine line work and lush detailed plants throughout. Preserve scene content; do not import the reference's river, hills, mushrooms or new animals or people. No frame, lettering, signature, watermark, or photographic leftovers.

execution_prompt_reading.zh: 用途：风格迁移。编辑图 1——一张阳光明媚、树叶繁茂的公共公园横向照片——仅将图 2 用作视觉风格参考。将同一座公园呈现为精致、细节丰富的新艺术与工艺美术式装饰田园插画。保留图 1 的 4:3 横向画幅、视角、构图、主要树木的位置与分枝剪影、层叠树冠、开阔草坪、横向步道、浓密的前景绿篱、横贯前景下方且大幅弯曲的低矮马赛克贴砖长椅／矮墙、铺装前景、右侧小长椅、远处建筑，以及原有小人物所在的位置。原照片中的地点必须依然清晰可辨。将所有部分统一转化为手绘童话绘画，准确沿用图 2 的视觉语言：纤细的暖金色轮廓线与叶脉、优雅的有机曲线、逐片绘制且繁密的枝叶与重复植物纹样、深森林绿、翡翠绿和清新的春绿、从间隙显露的浓郁钴蓝天空、象牙白与赭金高光、少量细小的暖红点缀、精密的织毯般细节、轻微的纸上水粉／油彩质感、明亮柔和的日光，以及迷人、宁静的田园气氛。将前景绿篱重绘为精巧的交叠植物叶片与细小花卉纹样，并用纤细金线勾边；将弧形贴砖长椅重绘为由绿、象牙白、赤褐和金色组成的精美小块马赛克，同时保留其原有形状与位置。用暖金色线条将现有树干风格化，保留浅色树干基部。如参考图所示，在原有可见蓝天区域中少量加入优雅的金色旋卷装饰。进行充分的绘画式风格转化：整幅完全插画化，优雅、制作精细，处处保有精致细线与茂盛而细节丰富的植物。保留场景内容；不要导入参考图中的河流、山丘、蘑菇，或新增动物、人物。不要添加边框、文字、签名或水印，也不要残留摄影画面。
